name: Deduplarr
description: Deduplarr is a Plex duplicate cleanup companion with an arr-style web UI for reviewing duplicate movie and episode versions before choosing what to keep.

paths.name: Config Folder
paths.description: Stores Deduplarr settings, saved Plex connection details, auth configuration, and keep preferences

ports.name: Web Port
ports.description: Container 7889 - Host port for the Deduplarr web UI

variables.name: Session Secret
variables.description: Optional long random value used to sign Deduplarr login sessions. Leave blank to generate one at startup; set it to keep sessions valid across container recreation.
